description: Full text of one article with its act, status, the date the corpus last checked the source, and provenance. Call it when you need the exact wording to quote. as_of=YYYY-MM-DD returns the wording in force on that date, reconstructed from the amendments with the amending law named (Russian codes). The norm text is always in its official language; lang only sets the language of the metadata. Also lists norms linked through the citation graph.

lang.description: language of the metadata envelope (not of the norm text)

name: lexatlas_get
title: Get article text
